fish.name: Galadion Goby
fish.desc: Amateur anglers are advised to familiarize themselves with the difference between the Merlthor and Galadion gobies as early as possible, as devotees of both varieties tend to become rather heated when one is (understandably) mistaken for the other. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Galadion Chovy
fish.desc: “What makes a Galadion chovy distinct from other Lominsan anchovies?” Depends on who's asking. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Leopard Eel
fish.desc: As per its namesake, it occupies a position fairly close to the top of the food chain, but is still forced to flee from larger and more dangerous predators. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Jasperhead
fish.desc: Sought for the gemlike objects that form in their stomachs, not in their heads, as the name might suggest. [Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.] [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Tarnished Shark

bonus.name: Certifiable Shark Hunters
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 200 or more sharks.

fish.desc: Like a long-neglected antique, perhaps this shark just needs some love to become the perfect addition to afternoon tea parties. Alas, no one has yet volunteered to be the first to find out. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Rosy Bream
fish.desc: The sunset coloring of these inhabitants of Galadion Bay makes them just as appealing to other predators as to anglers, leaving them somewhat beleaguered as a rule. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Cyan Octopus

bonus.name: Octopus Travelers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 150 or more octopodes.

fish.desc: Hunted for the copious amounts of ink it produces, the vast majority of which is spilled upon its capture. As a result, anglers with bright blue hands are a common sight around Galadion Bay. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Heavenswimmer
fish.desc: Easily spotted from afar due to their bright coloration, although sightings in the oceans surrounding Eorzea are scarce due to their unusual migratory patterns. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Spectral Megalodon
fish.desc: Due to the fact that most of its prey are petrified upon catching sight of this ominously glowing predator, it has rather an easy time finding a steady supply of food. [Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.] [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Drunkfish
fish.desc: If you had a face like this, you'd look sad, too. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Merman's Mane

bonus.name: Octopus Travelers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 150 or more octopodes.

fish.desc: Though the existence of mermen is much debated, if any were to exist, they would no doubt object to the comparisons drawn between their long locks and the tentacles of this grotesque cephalopod. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Heavenskey
fish.desc: Due to being highly poisonous, it is believed to send those who eat of its flesh to the heavens. Compared to the seven hells, this may prove a more desirable destination. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Ghost Shark

bonus.name: Certifiable Shark Hunters
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 200 or more sharks.

fish.desc: According to certain sources, it is able to appear spontaneously from any body of water. Such stories, however, are probably best ignored. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Fishmonger
fish.desc: Known for its habit of seeking out a variety of fish, though unlike its namesake, these are purely for its own consumption. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Navigator's Print
fish.desc: This denizen of the deep can proudly claim to take its name from a goddess, even if the tale behind it does involve being stepped on by said goddess. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Casket Oyster
fish.desc: While there are several theories surrounding the origin of its name, the general consensus is that it is as hard to open as a casket that has been nailed shut. However, it is nothing a brief spell in a pot of boiling water cannot solve. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Quicksilver Blade

bonus.name: Certifiable Shark Hunters
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 200 or more sharks.

fish.desc: While there may be larger and deadlier wavekin roaming the oceans, few can claim to be as hideous as this aberration of nature. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Funnel Shark

bonus.name: Certifiable Shark Hunters
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 200 or more sharks.

fish.desc: Its gaping maw draws in all manner of ocean life, along with a range of less-than-edible objects. [Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.] [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Nimble Dancer
fish.desc: Coveted by keepers of exotic fish for the mesmerizing manner in which its trailing fins catch the light. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Sothis
fish.desc: It is unclear how this species of turtle came to have a shell covered in glittering crystal, though it does give oceanic hunters pause for thought before they attempt to bite down on it. This could be considered a form of unnatural protection. [Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.] [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Ghoul Barracuda
fish.desc: Despite its considerable size, this ocean-dweller chooses to feast on the flesh of the dead rather than expend effort pursuing live prey. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: La Noscean Jelly

bonus.name: Jelled Together
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 150 or more jellyfish.

fish.desc: It was named as part of a movement to expunge the word “fish” from “jellyfish,” for reasons pertaining to consistency and accuracy, although this has met with little success thus far. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Sunfly
fish.desc: A brightly colored fish that swims merrily through the Strait of Merlthor...or did. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Marine Bomb

bonus.name: Balloon Catchers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more fugu.

fish.desc: Known more for its tendency to explode with rage in a figurative sense rather than a literal one, as its name might suggest. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Shaggy Seadragon

bonus.name: Maritime Dragonslayers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 100 or more seahorses.

fish.desc: Almost indistinguishable in appearance from the seaweed on which it feeds. It must take care not to overeat and thereby destroy its own hiding place from predators. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Momora Mora
fish.desc: Unlike the Lalafell from whom its name derives, this ocean-drifter is far from diminutive. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Merlthor Butterfly
fish.desc: Highly sought by aquarium owners for its vivid coloration, this increasingly rare species is arguably worth its weight in gold. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Gladius
fish.desc: A fish named after a sword─or was the sword named after the fish? [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Spectral Discus
fish.desc: This aetherially infused wavekin gathers rather a lot of unwanted attention, and it has no natural defenses to fend off curious predators. [Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.] [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Little Leviathan
fish.desc: Even a greatly scaled-down (pun very much intended) version of the Lord of the Whorl is more than a match for all but the most experienced fishers. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Sea Nettle

bonus.name: Jelled Together
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 150 or more jellyfish.

fish.desc: Not the most welcome of catches, as it tends to deliver a nasty sting to those whose hands wander too close. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Great Grandmarlin
fish.desc: More often than not, this hulking yet deceptively quick wavekin escapes the angler's hook, usually by severing the line with its blade-like bill. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Shipwreck's Sail
fish.desc: This wavekin is so broad and flat that it has been compared to the sail of a ship left to float on the tide. In actuality, it is waiting for seabirds to pick the parasites from its flanks. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Charlatan Survivor
fish.desc: At first glance, the charlatan survivor may appear to be a well-armored crustacean, but the outer shell is merely a purloined disguise concealing a much smaller creature beneath. Luckily, predatory wavekin are quite easily deceived and often choose to leave it alone in order to pursue less chitinous prey. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Hi-aetherlouse
fish.desc: An aetherially charged wavekin that has a habit of appearing when one least expects or wants it. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Azeyma's Sleeve
fish.desc: Many artist's impressions of Azeyma depict Her with flowing, bell-adorned sleeves, not unlike the elegant silhouette of this wavekin. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Aetheric Seadragon

bonus.name: Maritime Dragonslayers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 100 or more seahorses.

fish.desc: Framed in fabulous frond-like fins, this ferocious fish frequently frightens off foes who would fight for its feed. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Mythril Sovereign
fish.desc: Known for its beautifully shimmering scales, which are in contrast to its rather lackluster meat. [Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.] [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Roguesaurus
fish.desc: Named after the river rather than the traditional Lominsan profession. Those unfortunate enough to encounter one will testify that to describe it as roguish would be an understatement, and that “murderous,” “man-eating,” and “malevolent” would all be more applicable adjectives. [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Coral Manta
fish.desc: Few creatures can claim to have an entire ecosystem on their back, although this appears to afford the host no practical benefits whatsoever. [Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.] [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Floefish
fish.desc: This small, almost entirely defenseless fish forms an important link in the food chain─one quite near to the bottom. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Megasquid
fish.desc: One does not earn a name like “megasquid” by being small and unassuming, which this aquatic abomination certainly is not. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Oschon's Stone
fish.desc: Seemingly living up to its namesake, this heavy and largely immobile wavekin spends most of its life on the ocean floor. It feeds by opening its mouth and waiting for curious prey to swim inside. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Tossed Dagger
fish.desc: Often seen skimming the waves, shimmering like a blade in flight. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Tripod Fish

bonus.name: Balloon Catchers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more fugu.

fish.desc: Many a seafarer has lain awake contemplating the cursed knowledge that, as its name implies, this fish can indeed stand on its fins. [Suitable for display in aquariums tier 2 and higher.] [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Net Crawler

bonus.name: Crab Boat Crew
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more crabs.

fish.desc: Unlike most crabs, the main source of edible meat is found in the legs. The torso is often discarded as it mostly consists of hard gristle and unappetizing...matter. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Merlthor Lobster
fish.desc: As ubiquitous as they are delicious. A staple of seafood cuisine across Eorzea. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Elder Dinichthys
fish.desc: Swims about the Strait of Merlthor as though it owns the place─a claim which few of the other inhabitants are in any position to dispute. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Spectral Sea Bo
fish.desc: Its strange blue glow seems to have done wonders for its self-confidence, and it can be seen doing the underwater variation of strutting like a peacock...or whatever the chocobo equivalent of a peacock is. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Shooting Star
fish.desc: One's chances of seeing an actual shooting star are greater than that of being able to observe one of these rare wavekin in its natural habitat. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Hammerclaw
fish.desc: While most wavekin object quite strongly to being caught on a hook, these crustaceans make life especially difficult for anglers in retaliation. If they are not pinching fingers, they are flailing wildly with their heavy claws, both of which most fishers should and do go to great lengths to avoid. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Coccosteus
fish.desc: Revered by the Sahagin and reviled by practically everyone else. Its proclivity for biting fingers means that most who catch one end up wishing they hadn't. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Bartholomew the Chopper

bonus.name: Crab Boat Crew
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more crabs.

fish.desc: Suspected by some to be the reincarnation of an unhinged murderer, although it is also known to have a more amiable side. Well, about as amiable as one can expect from a wavekin that revels in killing. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Prowler
fish.desc: While the word “prowl” may suggest the slow, deliberate movement of one tracking its prey, this particular wavekin is simply slow by nature, mainly as a result of sheer indolence. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Mopbeard

bonus.name: Octopus Travelers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 150 or more octopodes.

fish.desc: Lifting it above the waterline causes it to transform from an elegant oceanic beauty to something resembling...well, a mop. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Wild Urchin
fish.desc: A creamy center encased in horrendously sharp spines. Only those who acquire the knack of eating one without impaling themselves can acquire the decidedly acquired taste. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Gugrusaurus
fish.desc: Spends most of its life attempting to slaughter anything and everything that it catches sight of. Considering the ample opportunities to practice such skills, it has become rather good at it. [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Coral Seadragon

bonus.name: Maritime Dragonslayers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 100 or more seahorses.

fish.desc: Dedicates its life to looking─and behaving─as much like coral as possible. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: The Fallen One
fish.desc: Believed by some to have descended from the heavens, and judging by the way it nervously flits about the ocean, it wishes it could return to whence it came. Few wavekin look less comfortable in their habitat than this unfortunate creature. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Elasmosaurus
fish.desc: In the harsh, unforgiving open sea, few creatures have proven a more valuable ally to mankind than the elasmosaurus. Though they are most often known to tow ships and carry out courageous acts of self-sacrifice, these gentle giants can also be lethally dangerous when angered. [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Rhotano Wahoo
fish.desc: Though it seems harmless enough at first glance, this fish has been rendered all but inedible by its highly poisonous diet. The taste is said to be exquisite by those brave enough to try it, however. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Rhotano Sardine
fish.desc: Usually seen traveling in large schools, these rather plain fish possess the group mentality of a flock of sheep─that is, to follow whoever is in front and, lacking that, just keep moving forward until something with big teeth appears. Then all hells break loose. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Deep Plaice
fish.desc: The name provides a useful hint as to the areas of the ocean this creature usually inhabits. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Crimson Monkfish
fish.desc: An angler never forgets the first time they reel in one of these deep-sea demons, no matter how hard they try. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Chrome Hammerhead

bonus.name: Certifiable Shark Hunters
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 200 or more sharks.

fish.desc: Differentiated from similar species by its unique coloration, which gives it a certain metallic sheen. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Ogre Eel
fish.desc: Even when it finds itself dangling from an angler's line, its only thought is to consume as much flesh as possible, which causes many a fisher to cast it back into the sea in sheer panic. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Dark Nautilus
fish.desc: Known for its ability to survive on aether alone, researchers are willing to part with huge sums of gil for live samples. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Lampfish

bonus.name: Balloon Catchers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more fugu.

fish.desc: Sought more for its roe than its meat. Thankfully its lack of muscular mass in comparison to the size of its body makes for an easy catch. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Spectral Bass
fish.desc: This most ordinary of fish has become rather extraordinary thanks to being bathed in otherworldly aether, giving it a fetching blue tinge. [Suitable for display in aquariums tier 3 and higher.] [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Sabaton
fish.desc: Strangely for a mollusk, its body is covered in hard scales in addition to the more common shell. Many predators will steer clear of them simply because they are a bother to eat. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Aronnax
fish.desc: Its remarkable speed is matched only by its unfathomable clumsiness, the combination of which often leads it straight into the waiting nets of fishers. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Sweeper

bonus.name: Certifiable Shark Hunters
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 200 or more sharks.

fish.desc: Its habit of moving its head from side to side while searching the seabed for food has earned it this unusual moniker. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Silencer

bonus.name: Balloon Catchers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more fugu.

fish.desc: While technically edible, it is not without side effects. Temporary loss of speech being the most noticeable, though there may be others that are harder to detect. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Deep-sea Eel
fish.desc: As may be inferred from the less-than-spectacular name, this eel resides in the sea. The deep part. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Executioner

bonus.name: Certifiable Shark Hunters
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 200 or more sharks.

fish.desc: Goes out of its way to make life as difficult as possible for those who enter its territory, including sawing holes in hulls and tearing through nets. [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Floating Saucer

bonus.name: Jelled Together
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 150 or more jellyfish.

fish.desc: Far less welcome at a mess hall table than an actual saucer, as these odd creatures taste rather like a sailor's subligar. Apparently. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: True Barramundi
fish.desc: This slow-moving, ponderous wavekin manages to avoid the attention of predators by being so unremarkable as to hardly warrant attention in the first place. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Prodigal Son
fish.desc: Rather than follow the standard migratory patterns of his brethren, this wandering wavekin swims to the beat of his own drum, and comes and goes as he pleases. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Slipsnail
fish.desc: While it may seem harmless enough, it has a nasty surprise in store for unwitting predators. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Stonescale
fish.desc: The thick covering of rock-like substance does little to improve this shark's mobility. Being an apex predator means it has little need of excessive armor plating. [Suitable for display in aquariums tier 4 and higher.] [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Tortoiseshell Crab

bonus.name: Crab Boat Crew
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more crabs.

fish.desc: Somewhere out there is bound to be a crabshell tortoise. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Lady's Cameo
fish.desc: Initially named after a famous piece of jewelry, it has since become a favorite among goldsmiths crafting pieces of their own. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Metallic Boxfish

bonus.name: Balloon Catchers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more fugu.

fish.desc: Although this wavekin only inflates to a box shape when threatened, having a fisher's hook through its lip seems to be enough to trigger this response. As a result, they are rarely seen in a deflated state. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Goobbue Ray

bonus.name: Sticking it to the Manta
bonus.req: Requirement: As an individual, catch 25 or more mantas.

fish.desc: While this wavekin has much in common with the goobbues from which it gained its name, perhaps most noticeable is the expression of gormless contentment permanently etched on its face. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Watermoura
fish.desc: While it moves with undeniable grace, the effect is rather spoiled by its brutish appearance. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: King Cobrafish
fish.desc: As a general rule, fish named after snakes are best left well alone. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Mamahi-mahi
fish.desc: Its decidedly maternal-sounding name alludes to its remarkable fecundity. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Lavandin Remora
fish.desc: Often confused with the similarly named lavender remora, but considering that they both taste more or less the same, this is little cause for concern. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Spectral Butterfly
fish.desc: Some believe their appearance to be an omen of considerable riches on the horizon. Considering that these wavekin fetch a pretty gil at market, perhaps there is some truth to it. [Suitable for display in aquariums tier 1 and higher.] [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Cieldalaes Geode
fish.desc: The true beauty of this wavekin is on the inside, whereas on the outside, it looks like a coblyn in a bad mood. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Titanshell Crab

bonus.name: Crab Boat Crew
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more crabs.

fish.desc: Those wishing to sample the succulent meat inside must first contend with its near-impenetrable shell. Or alternatively, have the fishmonger do that part for them beforehand. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Mythril Boxfish

bonus.name: Balloon Catchers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more fugu.

fish.desc: Valued more for its boxlike remains than for its meat, which is astonishingly mediocre. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Mistbeard's Cup
fish.desc: Judging by its volume, perhaps “Mistbeard's flagon” would have been a more apt name. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Anomalocaris Saron
fish.desc: At a certain point in history, this wavekin simply stopped evolving. Its lackluster appearance would suggest that this is not due to having achieved unsurpassable perfection, but rather a lack of ambition on the part of the species as a whole. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Flaming Eel
fish.desc: Sought more for its oil than for its meat, which is─as one might expect─rather oily. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Jetborne Manta

bonus.name: Sticking it to the Manta
bonus.req: Requirement: As an individual, catch 25 or more mantas.

fish.desc: Clever fishers will often latch onto one of these wavekin and use its extraordinary propulsion to pull their ships. Once it grows tired, they can repay its kindness by hauling it out of the water and eating it. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Devil's Sting
fish.desc: It is best to catch this vicious wavekin before it catches you. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Callichthyid
fish.desc: Being extremely heavy and covered in armored plates, attempting to catch and eat this wavekin is often more trouble than it is worth. Many fishers will cut their lines upon realizing they have snagged one. [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Meandering Mora
fish.desc: Content to simply drift through life with barely a care in the world, this fish is so lazy that it feeds by opening its mouth on the off chance that something edible might find its way inside. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Hafgufa
fish.desc: This man-eating wavekin is so vast and ferocious that catching it seems more like a task for hardened warriors than amateur fishers. [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Thaliak Crab

bonus.name: Crab Boat Crew
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more crabs.

fish.desc: Something of an anomaly among crabs as it spends its life moving back and forth between salt- and freshwater. Its flavor differs according to where it is caught. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Star of the Destroyer
fish.desc: Believed by some to be living fragments of Rhalgr's beacon, their gentle glow from beneath the waves is a welcome sight to many a sailor. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: True Scad
fish.desc: Let none doubt the trueness of this scad. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Blooded Wrasse
fish.desc: Fishers should not feel guilty for the bloodstains on the fish's head, as these are largely self-inflicted. They can instead feel guilty about the hook through the mouth, as well as the gutting and cleaning that comes shortly after. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Bloodpolish Crab

bonus.name: Crab Boat Crew
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more crabs.

fish.desc: These wavekin cover their claws in blood to make themselves presentable to potential mates. Though this may seem odd, perhaps it is best not to attempt to understand the inner workings of a crab's mind. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Blue Stitcher
fish.desc: Considering its thin legs are often likened to needles, one cannot expect to get much meat from them. The torso, on the other hand, is a firm favorite among seafarers. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Bloodfresh Tuna
fish.desc: Its blood red meat is the centerpiece of many expensive dishes, though some claim it is chosen more for its appearance than its taste. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Sunken Mask
fish.desc: Though inanimate objects are seldom a welcome sight on a fisher's line, the goblin owner of this mask would no doubt be prepared to pay a small fortune to have it returned. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Spectral Eel
fish.desc: Do not be fooled by its heavenly aura, for there is naught mystical about this wavekin. In fact, it should be battered over the head before it has the chance to bite someone. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Bareface
fish.desc: Said to resemble an unmasked goblin, not that most people would know what that looks like... [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Oracular Crab

bonus.name: Crab Boat Crew
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more crabs.

fish.desc: While bloodpolish crabs are certainly frightening, this larger and more violent relative is nothing less than a nightmare come to life. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Dravanian Bream
fish.desc: With all the hellish waterborne fiends and bizarre creatures that seem like the product of a fever dream, sometimes it makes a welcome change to meet a nice, normal fish. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Skaldminni

bonus.name: Sticking it to the Manta
bonus.req: Requirement: As an individual, catch 25 or more mantas.

fish.desc: Though it is said that this wavekin is the instrument of a fabled bard given life, the awkward flopping sound it makes when landed is anything but musical. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Serrated Clam
fish.desc: While this clam may look far more imposing than most, one must remind oneself that it is still only a clam, and only capable of causing a very limited amount of harm. Still, it is best to watch one's fingers, all the same. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Beatific Vision
fish.desc: After too long at sea, even this horrendously ugly fish can seem almost like a visitation from a divine being. Almost. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Exterminator

bonus.name: Crab Boat Crew
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more crabs.

fish.desc: Experienced fishers will make sure this insatiable wavekin is well and truly dead before putting it anywhere near their other catches, otherwise it will devour them in a matter of moments. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Gory Tuna
fish.desc: To survive amongst such vicious company, this fish needs to be tough, which some would say is reflected in the texture of its meat. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Ticinepomis
fish.desc: This fish moves so slowly that most other wavekin barely even realize it is alive, and pay it little heed. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Quartz Hammerhead

bonus.name: Certifiable Shark Hunters
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 200 or more sharks.

fish.desc: This shark possesses extraordinarily strong neck muscles, which it needs to stop itself being dragged down to the seabed by its weighty head. [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Seafaring Toad
fish.desc: The first sailors to spy one of these odd creatures at sea thought they had taken leave of their senses, or at the very least, had taken a wrong turn and somehow ended up in a pond. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Crow Puffer

bonus.name: Balloon Catchers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more fugu.

fish.desc: Though it may be both feared and revered by its ocean-dwelling neighbors, even the most potent of natural defenses means little when dangling from a fisher's line. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Rothlyt Kelp
fish.desc: There are far easier ways to gather kelp than by reeling it in clump by clump, but most fishers will gladly accept such a “catch” rather than throw it back into the sea. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Living Lantern

bonus.name: Jelled Together
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 150 or more jellyfish.

fish.desc: A living lantern has a number of uses, assuming one can keep it alive. After all, it only retains its lantern-like qualities while it is living, hence the name. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Honeycomb Fish

bonus.name: Balloon Catchers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more fugu.

fish.desc: It is remarkable how much this fish resembles a bee's nest, given that it has probably never even seen one before. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Godsbed
fish.desc: One should refrain from attempting to use this bivalve as a bed, since this tends to reduce its value in the eyes of potential buyers. If they find out about it, that is. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Lansquenet
fish.desc: Something of a mercenary among fish, it offers protection to smaller fish, though it seems to receive little in return. Perhaps it eats a few of them when the others are not looking? [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Thavnairian Shark

bonus.name: Certifiable Shark Hunters
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 200 or more sharks.

fish.desc: Although there are countless species of shark, the main concern among fishers is “How likely is it to eat me?” [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Nephrite Eel
fish.desc: Some experts believe that the young nephrite eel's coloration helps it to hide among seaweed, which protects it from larger predators and offers a place from which to ambush prey of its own. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Spectresaur
fish.desc: Eyewitnesses claim it to be the spirit of a long-dead seabeast. In truth, it is very much alive, which is probably a lot worse than if it were a ghost. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Ginkgo Fin
fish.desc: This minute wavekin cunningly disguises itself as a ginkgo leaf. This would be even more cunning, however, if ginkgo trees actually existed anywhere near the open sea. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Garum Jug

bonus.name: Balloon Catchers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more fugu.

fish.desc: Those able to fight their way past the ink-like liquid emitted by this fish in defense will be rewarded with a tasty snack and a useful container. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Smooth Jaguar
fish.desc: While there are many wavekin named after lions and tigers, the majestic jaguar is criminally underrepresented. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Rothlyt Mussel
fish.desc: Many fishmongers pride themselves on using every part of the creatures in which they deal. In the case of the mussel, however, there are only two parts to worry about: the shell and the...squishy thing inside. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Levi Elver
fish.desc: Of all the species of eel, levi elvers are said to most closely resemble Leviathan, although their much-reduced size does make them rather less imposing. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Pearl Bombfish

bonus.name: Balloon Catchers
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 250 or more fugu.

fish.desc: Although bombfish do not actually explode in the same way as their namesakes, they look as if they could were they so inclined, which is enough to deter many would-be predators. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Trollfish
fish.desc: Catching one of these brutes would be doing a great service to the other wavekin who share their waters. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Panoptes

bonus.name: Sticking it to the Manta
bonus.req: Requirement: As an individual, catch 25 or more mantas.

fish.desc: The myriad dots that resemble eyes are said to confuse certain predators. This only works, however, if said predator actually cares whether it has been seen. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Crepe Sole
fish.desc: The story goes that it was named after an item of footwear. Whether or not this is true, the fact remains that it looks like it has been stepped on. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Knifejaw
fish.desc: Must be handled with extreme care after being reeled in. Many fishers keep a long blade nearby to give it a good stabbing before even attempting to handle it. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Placodus
fish.desc: While its teeth specialize in crushing shellfish, it will not think twice before doing the same to a fisher's hands. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Deepshade Sardine
fish.desc: A dark-scaled fish that thought it could surreptitiously sneak through the shadows of a fishing boat and remain unnoticed. Alas, it thought wrong. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Sirensong Mussel

bonus.name: Maximum Mussel
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 350 or more shellfish.

fish.desc: A razor-sharp mollusk found in the Sirensong Sea. Those averse to paper cuts are advised not to touch the edges of its shell without proper protection. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Arrowhead

bonus.name: Squid Squadron
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 400 or more squid.

fish.desc: In eras past, squid of this sort were used as lethal projectiles. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Pink Shrimp

bonus.name: Shrimp Smorgasbord
bonus.req: Requirement: As an individual, catch 50 or more shrimp.

fish.desc: The prettiest, pinkest shrimp you ever did see...unless you've laid eyes on its vivid pink cousin. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Sirensong Mullet
fish.desc: Business in the front. Sirensong in the back. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Selkie Puffer
fish.desc: Perhaps this puffer could equip a racket and fur armguards and depart on a grand adventure. Or perhaps it's just a fish. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Poet's Pipe
fish.desc: Warning: not an actual musical instrument. Do not attempt to blow on it. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Marine Matanga
fish.desc: Proof that anything looks friendlier when it has Matanga features, even sharks. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Spectral Coelacanth
fish.desc: This coelacanth took to the spectral currents out of dissatisfaction with the evolutionary hand it was dealt─including, perhaps, its distinct lack of hands. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Dusk Shark
fish.desc: While known to scavenge the flesh of the drowned, this large grey shark will as surely feast upon the living. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Mermaid Scale

bonus.name: Maximum Mussel
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 350 or more shellfish.

fish.desc: These rainbow-colored mollusks are believed to come from mermaids. Alas, not a one has ever been sighted, suggesting they have no desire to explore up where we walk, up where we run, up where we stay all day in the sun. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Broadhead

bonus.name: Squid Squadron
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 400 or more squid.

fish.desc: A squid whose head and mind are both as sharp as an arrow. It puts little thought into its diet, however, and will eat anything it can sink its barbed beak into. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Vivid Pink Shrimp

bonus.name: Shrimp Smorgasbord
bonus.req: Requirement: As an individual, catch 50 or more shrimp.

fish.desc: A shrimp known for its vibrant and resilient pink shell, as well as its long, sharp pincers. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Sunken Coelacanth
fish.desc: A long-lived fish that makes its home in the deepest recesses of the ocean. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Siren's Sigh
fish.desc: A variety of anglerfish thought to be breath spilled from a siren's lips. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Black-jawed Helicoprion
fish.desc: Though this ancient sea-dweller lacks a powerful bite, it makes up for it with the ability to bludgeon and grind its prey against rocks. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Impostopus
fish.desc: This doppelganger of the deep is able to mimic prey using its tentacles as it approaches. The psychological trauma of being attacked by oneself─or perhaps a loved one that relatives would jokingly call one's twin─often paralyzes the victim as the impostopus feeds. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Jade Shrimp
fish.desc: A beautiful jade-colored shrimp that is the envy of many a sea creature. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Nymeia's Wheel
fish.desc: An ancient wavekin allegedly born of divine error─or divine clumsiness, at the least. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Taniwha
fish.desc: Respected and feared by the peoples of the south sea isles, this ancient sea creature is the subject of myriad myths and legends. [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Ruby Herring
fish.desc: Hingan merchants will offer fragrant samples of these toothsome fish when they do not care to haggle with their patrons, and thus its name has entered the local lexicon to refer to a misleading statement. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Whirlpool Turban

bonus.name: Maximum Mussel
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 350 or more shellfish.

fish.desc: Legend has it that this spiral wavekin possesses dominion over water, whipping up violent whirlpools and lacerating fishing vessels to shreds...but it is, at least, a very charming little shell. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Leopard Prawn

bonus.name: Shrimp Smorgasbord
bonus.req: Requirement: As an individual, catch 50 or more shrimp.

fish.desc: The unpredictable patterns on this crustacean's carapace indicate its freshness and depth of flavor when cooked. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Spear Squid

bonus.name: Squid Squadron
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 400 or more squid.

fish.desc: In recent days, dried varieties of this squid have gained popularity as a convenient snack for traveling lancers. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Floating Lantern
fish.desc: An elegant jellyfish that emits a warm, gentle glow akin to its namesake. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Rubescent Tatsunoko
fish.desc: Despite being maybe, possibly, improbably the juvenile form of a Ruby Dragon, this wavekin prefers hiding amongst colonies of leopard prawns to confrontation, and is thus the envy of introverted naturalists across the realm. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Hatatate
fish.desc: With a dorsal fin that makes it look like a standard-bearer, this saltwater fish is ready to charge bravely into a pitched battle under the sea. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Silent Shark
fish.desc: A species of shark that is silent but deadly─in the literal sense, children. In the literal sense. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Spectral Wrasse
fish.desc: Though this wavekin may be small, it attempts to remedy such shortcomings by sporting splendidly spectral scales. In doing so, however, it has become more vulnerable to predators and skilled anglers. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Mizuhiki
fish.desc: A fish of good fortune, said to strongly resemble white and red cords commonly used to wrap gifts in Hingashi. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Snapping Koban
fish.desc: This wavekin's golden fins and mouth appear as coins floating in the ocean, giving the impression that sailors of the Kugane coast are quite cavalier with their finances. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Silkweft Prawn

bonus.name: Shrimp Smorgasbord
bonus.req: Requirement: As an individual, catch 50 or more shrimp.

fish.desc: Some have spent fortunes to have a single taste of this succulent shrimp. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Stingfin Trevally
fish.desc: If the poisonous sacs of this stingfin are carefully removed, the meat can make for a perfectly adequate meal. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Swordtip Squid

bonus.name: Squid Squadron
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 400 or more squid.

fish.desc: True to its name, the head of this squid is sharp enough to pierce straight through plate armor. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Mailfish
fish.desc: A school of these fish creates a striking sheet of silver, like an enormous suit of chainmail drifting through the ocean blue. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Idaten's Bolt
fish.desc: Said to be blessed by the gods with blinding speed, sometimes these fish tire of water and propel themselves into the sky on the back of a spectral current. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Maelstrom Turban

bonus.name: Maximum Mussel
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 350 or more shellfish.

fish.desc: The presence of these shellfish in shallow waters is considered to be an ill omen, for they are believed to be the harbinger of storms, violent winds, and worse. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Shoshitsuki
fish.desc: The fleetness of these sharks is enough to tire even a god, but where divinity sees a menace, a fisher sees opportunity. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Spadefish
fish.desc: Which came first, the fish or the spade? [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Glass Dragon
fish.desc: Thought to be the counterpart of the Ruby Dragon, this legendary creature is far less fragile than its name implies. [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Crimson Kelp
fish.desc: Found in every corner of the Ruby Sea, this kelp is known and loved for its culinary versatility. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Reef Squid

bonus.name: Squid Squadron
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 400 or more squid.

fish.desc: A cephalopod that lays its eggs on the Ruby Sea's rocky reefs. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Pinebark Flounder
fish.desc: If a pinebark flounder splashes in the Ruby Sea and no one is around to hear it, does it make a sound? Far Eastern philosophers have yet to determine a definitive answer. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Mantle Moray
fish.desc: A moray that resembles an ethereal raiment worn by the Ruby Princess...if ethereal raiments looked as though they were about to utter the punchline to a groan-worthy joke. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Barded Lobster

bonus.name: Shrimp Smorgasbord
bonus.req: Requirement: As an individual, catch 50 or more shrimp.

fish.desc: If one were to liken the spiny lobster to a valiant knight, then the barded lobster─nearly twice the size of its counterpart─would serve as its seaworthy steed. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Shisui Goby
fish.desc: With its fondness for migratory journeys, this saltwater fish puts the “go” in “goby.” [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Sanbaso
fish.desc: Said to be an omen of ample harvests, this wavekin is named for a traditional dance passed down in the Far East. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Violet Sentry
fish.desc: As dreadful as it is, people would be forgiven for mistakenly calling this seabeast the “violent sentry.” [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Spectral Snake Eel
fish.desc: Now that its spectral nature has taken precedence, the question of whether this wavekin is a snake or an eel has become irrelevant. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Heavensent Shark
fish.desc: This shark is believed to be the reincarnation of a tiger descended from Heaven-on-High. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Fleeting Squid

bonus.name: Squid Squadron
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 400 or more squid.

fish.desc: When winter descends upon Kugane and its vibrant flora wilts, some look to the sea, where the skin of this cephalopod reminds them of warmer seasons. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Bowbarb Lobster

bonus.name: Shrimp Smorgasbord
bonus.req: Requirement: As an individual, catch 50 or more shrimp.

fish.desc: The long whiskers of this massive lobster curve like a bow, and some Kugane children cannot resist playing at imaginary war around the dinner table. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Pitch Pickle
fish.desc: Biting into the flesh of this wavekin will stain one's entire mouth black, which is useful if you have occasion to disguise yourself as ancient Far Eastern nobility. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Senbei Octopus
fish.desc: This wavekin resembles a popular Kugane treat outside of the water, causing sailors to look twice when rummaging through supplies for a late-night snack. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Tentacle Thresher
fish.desc: Displaying an almost exclusive predilection for preying on octopodes, this wavekin shows that even nature's deadliest predators can be picky eaters. [Suitable for printing on extra large canvases.]

fish.name: Bekko Rockhugger
fish.desc: The round body of this wavekin allows it to be carried swiftly through the ocean's currents, which might explain why it clings so desperately to the ocean's rocks. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Yellow Iris
fish.desc: Like its namesake flower, this fish has put many local ecosystems at risk. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Crimson Sentry
fish.desc: It takes little imagination to guess how this shark, one of two guardians keeping vigil over Shisui of the Violet Tides, got its name. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Flying Squid

bonus.name: Squid Squadron
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 400 or more squid.

fish.desc: What dried flying squid lacks in flavor, it makes up for in sheer quantity, and it is a staple in the diets of the Kugane commonfolk. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Hells' Claw
fish.desc: Protected by a thick layer of volcanic rock, this crustacean swims through the depths of the Ruby Sea to keep the flesh inside its shell from cooking. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Catching Carp
fish.desc: If only it knew where to find a pitching carp. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Garlean Bluegill
fish.desc: Though this invasive wavekin may appear harmless at first glance, the Yanxians will stop at nothing to hunt these tiny blue terrors down. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Yanxian Softshell
fish.desc: The world may be hard and cold, but this turtle's shell is soft...and questionably warm. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Princess Salmon
fish.desc: Not deigning to leave her domain, the princess salmon always remains in the waters of the One River. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Calligraph
fish.desc: When told the tale of this fish's creation, a Doman boy is said to have attempted to create more fish with inky scales. It did not end well for the carp in his father's prized pond. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Singular Shrimp

bonus.name: Shrimp Smorgasbord
bonus.req: Requirement: As an individual, catch 50 or more shrimp.

fish.desc: A small shrimp whose deep green hue is said to be a reflection of the One River. But more importantly, it's delicious. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Brocade Carp
fish.desc: Beautifully patterned and vibrantly hued, this freshwater fish has long been farmed in the One River for ornamental purposes. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Yanxian Sturgeon
fish.desc: A large freshwater fish whose eggs are considered so delicious, it gave rise to the saying “hoes before roe”─a reminder that work precedes pleasure. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Spectral Kotsu Zetsu
fish.desc: The bone-like tongues of these spectral wavekin are surprisingly sturdy despite their crystalline appearance, and are often used by highly skilled artisans to craft priceless accessories. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Fishy Shark
fish.desc: A large shark that, despite its size, prefers living among the reeds of the One River. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Gensui Shrimp

bonus.name: Shrimp Smorgasbord
bonus.req: Requirement: As an individual, catch 50 or more shrimp.

fish.desc: The green carapace of this shrimp is said to be the same emerald hue as the sweeping hills that make up the Gensui Chain. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Yato-no-kami
fish.desc: This wavekin makes an appearance in the folklore of Yanxia, where it is depicted as a demon who leaves the land fallow. Best eat it to prevent the tales coming true. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Heron's Eel
fish.desc: Although their early life is spent in Heron's Way, these eels eventually make their way to bigger ponds. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Crowshadow Mussel

bonus.name: Maximum Mussel
bonus.req: Requirement: As a party, catch 350 or more shellfish.

fish.desc: A bivalve mollusk whose pitch-black shell hides a dazzling interior. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Yanxian Goby
fish.desc: Drawn down the One River from the Azim Steppe, these fish grow fat upon the smaller specimens inhabiting spectral currents. [Suitable for printing on small canvases.]

fish.name: Iridescent Trout
fish.desc: The scales of these fish are highly sought after by artisans in Kugane and beyond. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Un-Namazu
fish.desc: Believed to be a Namazu fallen from grace, this fish can not so much as affirm or deny the claim. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Gakugyo
fish.desc: Once the subject of a Far Eastern faerie tale, this wavekin may or may not seek revenge after being used by an adventurous rabbit. [Suitable for printing on large canvases.]

fish.name: Ginrin Goshiki
fish.desc: Valued for its vibrant scales, this variety of carp is occasionally mistaken for a gold ingot when viewed from above the water's surface. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]

fish.name: Jewel of Plum Spring
fish.desc: Thought to be birthed from the gnarled trunk of an ancient plum tree, the blossoms atop this legendary turtle's shell neither wither nor fade with the passage of time. [Suitable for printing on medium canvases.]
